title: Uncle Matt: missiles disabled at Malmstrom all the time

tellings.quote: happens all the time. These things would happen and disable the nuclear weapons.

plain: In the early 1970s at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, unexplained things are said to have shut down the base's nuclear missiles, and this "happens all the time." Kevin Knuth, a guest on an episode billed as a NASA whistleblower's story, says his uncle Matt LaCroix told him this. If true, something unknown was repeatedly switching off America's nuclear weapons.
